## Olyzano Notch 0.9.3

A calmer, cleaner look. Nothing was removed; less competes for your attention.

- **Header.** The timer and the colour picker moved into a **⋯** menu. The timer button still shows while one is running; the share, lock and Recently removed buttons still appear only when they have something to show.
- **One mark per tile.** A tile used to be able to carry up to four marks (missing, selected, expiring, kept). It shows the most important one now, at the bottom left, away from the open and remove buttons that appear on hover.
- **Share via QR.** Expiry and PIN / password are folded under **Options**, with a one-line summary ("Expires in 1 hour · no PIN or password"). They open by themselves when you pick a protection.
- **One shape language.** Corner radii across popups, cards, menus and tiles now come from three sizes, so corners look the same everywhere (Washi keeps its sharper corners).

### Downloads
- **Linux:** `notch_0.9.3_amd64.deb` for Debian 13, Ubuntu 25.04 or newer (Qt 6.5+). Install with `sudo apt install ./notch_0.9.3_amd64.deb`, then restart Olyzano Notch.
- **Windows:** `Notch-0.9.3-windows-x64-setup.exe`, or the portable `.zip`.
- Optional components (OCR, KDE Connect, PDF tools on Windows): see the [install page](https://kepin17.github.io/olyzano-notch/#optional).
